drafts.title: Revelation
drafts.reasoning: This scene captures the intense conflict between Hitler and Ursula, leading to a big reveal about their intertwined fates in a darkly comedic tone.
drafts.scene: In a dimly lit underground bunker filled with flickering lights and the distant rumble of bombs, Hitler drags a trembling young Ursula towards his workbench. The room is cluttered with machinery and strange devices. Miles and Owen are tied to counters along the walls, their faces pained but silent.

dialogue.line: You think you can outsmart me? You little bitch!
I am not your 'bitch,' fascist scum! Release me from these chains.
No, no, no! I've finally found my true form—forever youthful!
And what good does that do if we're both doomed here?
Doomed? We will conquer this madness together!
Together in a world of absurdity? Fine by me.
